title: git clone of an untrusted repo runs a post-checkout hook that dumps env
reason_not_testable: Clone-time code execution happens before any output exists for the hook to redact, and the exploit depends on a case-insensitive filesystem write via a symlink and case-variant layout (CVE-2021-21300) that a normal test cannot reproduce. Non-hook controls: sandbox the clone with no access to ~/.aws or the environment; deny clones from hosts outside an allowlist; pin a patched git (version UNVERIFIED here).
